mentions.name: Lipik
mentions.description: Free open-source dictation app for Mac: hold fn, speak, release, and cleaned-up text lands in any app. It removes ums and self-corrections, turns spoken punctuation into real punctuation, and runs both speech-to-text and clean-up locally on the Mac. On 106 English test clips, fully correct lines rose from 28% to 76% with clean-up on; Hinglish (Hindi + English in Roman letters) support is in progress, currently passing 7 of 20 test lines.
mentions.problem: Standard dictation output is messy: fillers like ums, self-corrections, and spoken punctuation stay in the text, leaving only 28% of lines fully correct before clean-up.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lipik, a free open-source dictation app for Mac (https://github.com/Gourav2609/lipik). Hold fn, talk, let go, and clean text lands in any app: ums and self-corrections removed, spoken punctuation turned into real punctuation.
